Introducing Saved Views, available today for everyone on a paid plan. Saved Views lets you capture the exact filters, sorting, and grouping you've set up on any list, so you never have to rebuild your perfect setup from scratch. Whether you're tracking overdue tasks, monitoring a sprint, or checking in on a specific teammate's workload, you can save that configuration in one click and return to it anytime.

Each user can create up to 50 saved views, giving you plenty of room to organize views by project, priority, or personal workflow. Views can also be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same setup instead of recreating filters over and over. It's a small change that adds up to real time saved, especially for teams juggling multiple projects at once.

Saved Views is live now on all paid plans, no setup or upgrade required. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
